name: pilgrimage
scope: Pilgrimage makes Goldwind the fresh-settings default and adds two seeded chapter families: The Lantern Causeway and The Ashen Archive. Authored modules carry ordinary routes, conditional crossings, firing lanes, supported Blink landings, service shortcuts and role-based encounters. Geometry, encounter, loot and decoration randomness are independent. Existing explicit Classic preferences, three legacy layouts, old runs and rewards remain.
fieldwork: Fresh grip takes or pulls visible supplies before disk acquisition, with cancellation and exact gain feedback. Default contact collection uses the same body-height and line-of-sight rule after walking or teleportation; saved Manual preferences remain. The immersive Missions browser exposes new and original campaigns. Separate AR expedition retains the selected world's real exploration and progress, unlike stationary Sanctuary or paused inspection. Transient projectile audio bookkeeping no longer blocks checkpoint writes.
saveCompatibility: Goldwind is the fresh-settings default; an explicitly saved Classic choice is respected. New chapter saves freeze generator identity, seed, tier and mechanism state. All three older layout readers, profile/envelope keys, one-time reward receipts and old-run continuation are retained. The new route ends in retained Endless after two chapters. AR expedition preserves normal progress; Sanctuary and inspection preserve their suspended-expedition contracts.
hardwareStatus: Development release. Model samples and input-driven native/public WebGL verification are separate from physical Quest 3/Xbox, comfort, sustained performance and human comprehension. New chapters use representative original graybox-first architecture, not finished biome art. AR does not scan furniture, anchor geometry to physical surfaces or make virtual floors safe to walk on.

hotfix.name: Wayfinder
hotfix.scope: Visible mechanism and exit affordances, objective wrist card and grip progression. Existing world identities, chapter length, save and reward contracts unchanged. See WAYFINDER.md and the separate publication receipt.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.scope: World-anchored adjustable XR desk and a checkpoint-protected walking round trip to a local Vesperfall foyer. No private hub integration, cross-site travel, sphere portals, altered saved geometry or desktop UI replacement. See THRESHOLD.md and its separate verification evidence.
